git-workflow-and-versioning.description: Structure the git workflow for any code change: branch, commit atomically, write commit messages, split a messy working tree into clean commits, resolve conflicts, push, open and review pull requests, cut releases, pick a semantic version bump, tag, and write changelogs. Use whenever a change is about to be committed or any git operation is discussed. Vietnamese triggers: 'commit', 'tach commit', 'viet commit message', 'tao nhanh', 'merge', 'xu ly conflict', 'tao PR', 'danh version', 'viet changelog'. Russian triggers: 'сделать коммит', 'разбить на коммиты', 'релиз'. Use it even when the diff is pasted inline and the message looks trivial.
git-workflow-and-versioning.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell, run_commands/read_files/editor, no subagents; see the Cline notes.

documentation-and-adrs.description: Record decisions and documentation: architecture decision records (ADR), the reasoning behind a design choice, README and API docs updates when a public interface changes, release notes, and the context future engineers and agents need to understand the codebase. Use when a decision must be written down or the documentation is missing or stale. Vietnamese triggers: 'viet ADR', 'ghi lai quyet dinh kien truc', 'viet tai lieu', 'cap nhat README', 'document quyet dinh'. Russian triggers: 'написать ADR', 'оформить решение', 'обновить документацию'. Not for writing marketing copy.
documentation-and-adrs.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell, run_commands/read_files/editor, no subagents; see the Cline notes.

code-review-and-quality.description: Run a multi-axis code review before merging: correctness, design, readability, naming, error handling, performance, security, tests and simplicity. Use when reviewing your own diff, another agent's change or a human pull request, when a change is about to enter the main branch, or when the user asks to review code. Vietnamese triggers: 'review code', 'soat code', 'kiem tra code truoc khi merge', 'danh gia chat luong code'. Russian triggers: 'ревью кода', 'проверить код перед merge'. Works on a pasted diff as well as on a checked-out branch.
code-review-and-quality.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell, run_commands/read_files/editor, no subagents; see the Cline notes.

impeccable.description: Design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, simplify, harden, animate, or otherwise improve a frontend interface: websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, components, forms, settings, onboarding, empty states, and native iOS or Android screens. Covers UX review, hierarchy, layout, typography, color, motion, UX copy, accessibility, responsive behavior, edge cases, and design systems (DESIGN.md, tokens); also making bland UI bolder, loud UI quieter, or building ambitious visual effects. Trigger it whenever the user mentions UI, UX, a screen, a page, layout, components, styling, CSS, Tailwind, a screenshot to fix, or says things like 'làm đẹp giao diện', 'sửa UI', 'thiết kế lại trang', 'giao diện xấu quá', 'review giao diện', 'audit UI', 'улучшить интерфейс', 'сделать красиво', 'design review' — even when the request looks like a small CSS tweak. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.
impeccable.compatibility: Cline on Windows. Shell steps use run_commands/PowerShell; the design-detector launcher is optional (degraded mode documented below); subagent workflows are replaced by reference/degraded/*.md.

manim.description: Build math/physics/CS animations with Manim Community Edition in Python: Scenes and Mobjects, timed animations, LaTeX/MathTex equation morphs, graphs and ValueTracker updaters, 3D scenes and moving camera, then render to MP4/GIF from the CLI with a render-a-frame-first verify loop. Trigger when the user asks to make a math animation, animate an equation or formula, morph one formula into another, plot or animate a graph/function, trace a dot along a curve, animate a geometric proof, build a 3Blue1Brown-style explainer, or visualize a math/physics/CS concept as a video. Vietnamese triggers: 'lam video minh hoa toan', 'animate cong thuc', 've do thi dong', 'dung canh 3D', 'xuat MP4/GIF tu Python'. Russian triggers: 'анимация формулы', 'анимировать график', 'ролик в стиле 3Blue1Brown', 'визуализировать теорему'. Not for UI motion, Remotion/social video, or CSV business charts.
manim.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell shell, python -m manim (Manim CE 0.22.1), ffmpeg/ffprobe and MiKTeX installed; the upstream bash helpers are ported to PowerShell in scripts/; no subagents.

design-taste-frontend.description: Build a professional company website at the level of figma.com and x.ai instead of a generic template: plain copy, one design system, one section per screen, equal edges, real photographs and real product UI, real brand icons, quiet hover micro-interactions, shader effects and scenes only on tech, gaming and software pages, plus a headless-browser checker that enforces all of it. Use for building, designing, redesigning, restyling, polishing or reviewing a landing page, company, product, shop, cafe, hotel, studio, SaaS, AI, developer-tool or game site in any stack: HTML/CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind. Vietnamese triggers: lam landing page, thiet ke lai trang, trang trong chung chung, web trong nhu AI lam, sua giao dien. Russian triggers: сделать нормальный лендинг, страница выглядит шаблонно, переделай сайт. Also use it when a page looks generic, templated or AI-made. Not for backend-only work or a Word, PDF or spreadsheet deliverable.
design-taste-frontend.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell shell, run_commands/read_files/editor, Node 22+ and Chrome or Edge found by the scripts themselves (headless, no packages); scripts/check_env.mjs reports what is missing and the build waits for the user yes; no subagents, and browser tools never replace the skill own checkers.
replacements: `<skill>` is the skill folder named in the Cline runtime notes above.

archify.description: Turn an idea, plan, requirement, Mermaid source or an existing codebase into a validated, explorable standalone HTML diagram: architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle and state, ERD, class, tree, timeline, waterfall; also one-page explainers with the conclusion first. Use when the user asks to draw, visualize, map or explain a system, an API call chain, a pipeline, a schema, a process, a state machine, a history, timing or a repository structure, or wants an answer delivered as a shareable page. Vietnamese triggers: 've so do', 'lam so do kien truc', 'so do luong du lieu', 'so do tuan tu', 'so do lop', 've erd', 'so do trang thai', 'giai thich bang mot trang'. Russian triggers: 'нарисуй схему', 'схема архитектуры', 'диаграмма последовательности', 'схема базы данных', 'объясни одной страницей'. Not for dashboards, charts built from data files, or slide decks.
archify.compatibility: Cline on Windows: PowerShell shell, run_commands/read_files/editor, Node 18+ in PATH (v24 present), no npm install needed because the package is self-contained and dependency-free, no subagents; browser-based preview and visual-check degrade to manual review; see the Cline runtime notes inside.
